subject: On-prem air-gapped qualification & deployment timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Leah Summers <leah@genomex.com>, Genomex Procurement <procurement@genomex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:12:00-05:00
Subject: On-prem air-gapped qualification & deployment timeline

Hi Leah / Genomex team —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on procurement and scheduling: 

Recap (items we agreed to investigate):
- Hardware SKU options: you asked about H100 vs A100 80GB; we noted both are supported but H100 will reduce latency for long-sequence workloads.
- Rack & power: minimum 2U per GPU node; need final RU allocation from Tom for floor planning.
- Offline patching cadence: Genomex prefers quarterly patch windows; we discussed dry-run patch process in lab.
- Key management: we discussed customer-managed HSM vs Redwood KMS with sealed offline key import.
- Audit & logs: you requested retained audit logs (90 days) and an exportable SOC2 evidence bundle.
- Spares & rollback: suggested 1 spare NVMe drive and 1 spare PSU per cluster; rollback MOP required.

Attachments I shared: redwood_onprem_mop_draft.pdf, hardware_requirements_matrix.xlsx (attached). Please reply with the inventory spreadsheet (we requested Tom to provide RU/serial numbers).

Proposed next steps: 
1) Engineering scoping session (remote, 60m) — proposed Wed 2026-12-08 11:00 AM ET. We'll bring Karthik and Marissa to validate firmware and cabling needs.
2) Dry-run patch in Redwood lab (two-week window) — proposed week of 2027-01-09. This is where we'll run the airgapped patch flow and key import.
3) Procurement sync (contract & PO milestones) — propose connecting procurement team after scoping.

If the above looks good, please: (a) attach the inventory spreadsheet (Tom), (b) confirm the scoping slot or propose alternatives, and (c) flag any non-negotiable security constraints.

Cheers,

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0198

From: Leah Summers <leah@genomex.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Genomex Procurement <procurement@genomex.com>, Tom Keller <tkeller@genomex.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T17:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: On-prem air-gapped qualification & deployment timeline

Rafael —

Appreciate the summary. Attached is the inventory export Tom pulled this afternoon (genomex_inventory_20261205.xlsx). A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Firmware and BIOS: we run vendor-signed firmware and require a vetted upgrade path; any proposed lab dry-run must mirror our baseline images. Will your dry-run use identical firmware versions or will there be an image handoff?
- Patch cadence: quarterly is our target but we may need an accelerated security patch process if a CVE affects components. Please confirm how Redwood handles emergency offline patches and verification.
- Key management: we prefer hardware-backed keys. If Redwood recommends KMS, please outline the sealed import process and attestations for key handling.
- Procurement: we'll need a preliminary SOW and initial pricing for Dedicated vs Private (capital vs SaaS). Procurement will also require DocuSign-ready MSA terms and a standard PO template.

I've CC'd procurement. Tom — can you confirm RU/serials and whether you can make the scoping slot on Wed 12/08?

Thanks,
Leah Summers
Head of Ops, Genomex
leah@genomex.com
[Attachment: genomex_inventory_20261205.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T18:26:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: On-prem air-gapped qualification & deployment timeline

Forwarding Leah's inventory and notes. Proposed internal plan before the scoping call: 

- Pre-scope checklist (we should complete these 48h before the scoping session):
  • Validate Genomex firmware baseline (ask Tom for exact versions).
  • Prepare lab image that matches vendor-signed firmware; we will capture SHA256 sums and bring a write‑protected USB for the lab test.
  • Draft an offline patch playbook (attached: onprem_patch_playbook_v1.docx) that covers staging, verification, and rollback steps.

- HSM vs KMS: Recommend we propose two options to the customer: (A) customer-managed HSM with remote attestation and sealed import (preferred for regulated workloads), (B) Redwood KMS with sealed offline key import and an audited key custodian process. I'll draft text describing the sealed import flow for the scoping call.

- Dry-run lab: propose a 4-hour window in lab for a full patch cycle including key import, patch staging, and verification. Results and logs will be handed to Genomex for their audit records.

Action items for internal owners: 
- Ben: lead procurement/price comparison for Dedicated vs Private and produce an initial TCO slide (Ben).
- Marissa: prep the MOP draft and rollback checklist (Marissa).
- Rafael: confirm scoping time and handle procurement regional SLA asks.

Attaching draft playbook and will add the sealed-import diagram before the call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onprem_patch_playbook_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Leah / Tom / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the inventory. Attached is a short mutual action plan (rdw_mutual_action_plan_20261206.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. Highlights: 

- Scoping session: Wed 2026-12-08 11:00 AM ET (60m) — Karthik / Marissa to lead technical validation.
- Lab dry-run: 2027-01-11 09:00–13:00 ET (4h) — full offline patch + key import.
- Procurement milestones: draft SOW by 2026-12-15; draft MSA for initial review by 2026-12-17; target PO issuance by 2027-01-20.

We have also created a DocuSign envelope for the preliminary MSA terms to speed procurement review: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/rdw-msb-78943. Procurement, if you prefer a different signing flow, tell us and we'll adapt.

Ben will follow up with high-level cost comparatives for Dedicated vs Private by EOD 2026-12-07. Marissa will circulate a revised MOP that includes rollback validation steps and spare parts list.

Please confirm: (1) scoping slot, (2) Tom's availability to provide firmware/BIOS versions before the call, and (3) procurement's preferred contract flow.

Best,

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
